title: Az étteremben
intro: You're having lunch at a small étterem near your office. The waiter comes over.

a.speaker: Pincér
a.textEn: Hello! How many of you will there be?

choices.note: Sounds funny! For "just me" say Egyedül vagyok or Egy főre (for one person).

b.speaker: Pincér
b.text: Tessék, itt az étlap. Mit hozhatok inni?
b.textEn: Here's the menu. What can I bring you to drink?
b.textRo: Poftiți meniul. Ce vă pot aduce de băut?

choices.textRo: O apă de la robinet, vă rog.
choices.note: Perfectly normal in Hungary. A few places charge a little for tap water (csapvíz).

c.speaker: Pincér
c.text: Választott már? A napi menü ma gulyásleves és rántott csirke.
c.textEn: Have you chosen yet? Today's set menu is goulash soup and breaded chicken.
c.textRo: Ați ales? Meniul zilei azi e supă gulaș și pui pane.

choices.textEn: I'm vegetarian. What do you recommend?

c2.speaker: Pincér
c2.text: A rántott sajt nagyon finom, rizzsel és tartárral.
c2.textEn: The fried cheese is very good, with rice and tartar sauce.
c2.textRo: Cașcavalul pane e foarte bun, cu orez și sos tartar.

d.speaker: Pincér
d.textEn: Enjoy your meal! … Did you like it?

choices.textEn: It was delicious! I'd like to pay.
choices.textRo: A fost foarte bun! Aș dori să plătesc.

choices.text: Kártyával. És a borravaló tíz százalék.
choices.textEn: By card. And the tip is ten percent.
choices.textRo: Cu cardul. Și bacșișul e zece la sută.
choices.note: Tipping is usually 10–15% in Hungary. Check the bill first: some places already add a service charge (szervízdíj).

choices.text: Készpénzzel. Köszönöm, a többi a magáé.
choices.textEn: Cash. Thank you, keep the change.
choices.textRo: Numerar. Mulțumesc, restul e al dumneavoastră.
